name: qi21_public_v1
about: Qwen Image 2.1 multi-stage bench: hand-written stress prompts — a vending machine (glass/transparent bottles, dense Japanese+English lettering) and a rainy Tokyo izakaya alley (lantern and sign lettering, rain reflections, a backlit figure) — and an ukiyo-e woodblock wave whose fine foam is very sensitive to the hand-off σ — fixed seeds and sizes. Reference = 25 steps (cfg 1 ×20, cfg 3 ×5).

samples.label: vending machine (glass + dense JP/EN text) seed 51
samples.text: A vertical realistic night photograph of a glowing Japanese vending machine standing alone on a quiet Tokyo street corner, its cool white fluorescent light spilling onto wet asphalt. The machine is painted glossy red with a slightly scratched metal frame. Across the top of the machine, a wide illuminated header panel reads "COLD DRINKS" in bold white sans-serif letters, and directly below it a smaller blue band reads "つめた〜い" on the left half and "あったか〜い" in red on the right half. Behind a large clear glass front panel, three rows of drink samples stand side by side, the glass reflecting faint streetlights and a few raindrops. The top row holds six clear plastic PET bottles: a green tea bottle labeled "緑茶" with "GREEN TEA" underneath, a clear water bottle labeled "天然水" and "MINERAL WATER", a pale yellow bottle labeled "レモンソーダ" and "LEMON SODA", a brown bottle labeled "麦茶", a transparent sparkling water bottle labeled "SPARKLING WATER", and an orange juice bottle labeled "オレンジ 100%". The middle row holds six aluminium cans: a black coffee can labeled "ブラックコーヒー" and "BLACK COFFEE", a white can labeled "ミルクティー" and "MILK TEA", a red cola can labeled "COLA", a blue can labeled "SPORTS DRINK", a green can labeled "抹茶ラテ", and a gold can labeled "CAFE LATTE". The bottom row holds four small clear glass bottles of ramune and milk, labeled "ラムネ", "牛乳", "コーンスープ" and "ココア". Beneath every sample is a small white price tag with a lit button: "¥130", "¥110", "¥150", "¥160" and "¥180", some buttons glowing "売切" in red. On the lower right of the machine a coin slot is labeled "100円 50円 10円" and a card reader panel reads "IC CARD OK". A dark gray recycling bin beside the machine is labeled "空き缶・ペットボトル" and "CANS & BOTTLES". The lighting is the machine's own bright cold glow, with soft reflections on the glass and wet ground; the surrounding street is dim and blue. The overall composition is centered and frontal, crisp and detailed, every label clearly legible.

samples.label: Tokyo rainy izakaya: lanterns, signboards, chalkboard menu, backlit passer-by seed 71
samples.text: A vertical realistic night photograph of a narrow Tokyo back alley in the rain, looking toward the entrance of a small traditional izakaya. On the left, a row of four glowing red paper lanterns hangs from the eaves, each painted with large black brush-stroke characters: the nearest reads "居酒屋", the next "焼き鳥", then "酒", then "おでん". Above the sliding wooden door hangs a dark indigo noren curtain split into three panels printed with white characters reading "とりまる". A backlit vertical signboard on the right wall glows warm white with bold black gothic letters reading "炭火焼鳥 とりまる" and a smaller line below reading "OPEN 17:00-24:00". In the lower left, a small black chalkboard A-frame stands on the wet pavement, hand-written in white chalk: "本日のおすすめ" on the top line, then "生ビール ¥500" and "焼き鳥盛り合わせ ¥980", with a small drawing of a beer mug. Rain falls in fine silver streaks through the lantern light, and the wet asphalt mirrors the red lanterns and the white sign in long rippling reflections. Far down the alley, a motorcycle approaches with its single headlight glaring straight toward the camera, backlighting a lone passer-by in a dark coat holding a clear plastic umbrella, whose silhouette and umbrella edge are rimmed by the headlight glow; the headlight blooms softly in the rainy air. Tangled overhead power lines, air-conditioner units and a stack of beer crates line the walls. The lighting is warm red and amber from the lanterns against the cold blue of the night and the white backlight from the motorcycle. The overall composition is a deep one-point perspective down the alley, moody, cinematic and rain-soaked, every large sign clearly legible.

samples.label: ukiyo-e woodblock: Taipei 101 behind a great wave, cursive poem in large/medium/small characters (fine foam = hand-off σ probe) seed 36
samples.text: A horizontal Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print in the style of Hokusai, showing Taipei 101 rising behind an enormous breaking wave. In the foreground, a colossal Prussian-blue wave curls from the left across the frame, its crest breaking into claw-like white foam fingers that spray tiny droplets over the sea; smaller waves ripple below with fine parallel carved lines and white foam dots. In the middle distance, the tower of Taipei 101 stands slightly left of center, drawn as a stack of eight flared pagoda-like segments in muted green-grey and ochre with crisp black keyblock outlines, its spire piercing a pale sky. Three narrow wooden fishing boats with crouching rowers in straw hats ride the troughs of the waves at lower right, tilted steeply. A pale beige sky with soft horizontal bokashi gradation fades to a light blue band near the horizon, and a few stylised flat clouds float at upper right. In the upper left corner, a vertical rectangular cartouche in light yellow holds black brush calligraphy reading "台北百一 波裏" with a small red square seal below it. Along the right edge of the print, a poem is brushed in flowing semi-cursive grass-script calligraphy in black sumi ink, written in four vertical columns read from right to left: "巨浪捲天來", "高樓立不移", "漁舟翻白雪", "笑看海風吹". The characters vary in size like a scholar's inscription: the first column is large and bold with thick, dry-brush strokes, the middle columns are medium-sized and lighter, and the last column trails off smaller, followed by a tiny signature line "波裏客題" in small cursive and a small red square seal. The palette is limited to Prussian blue, indigo, ochre, grey-green, beige and white, printed with visible wood grain texture and slightly uneven ink density on washi paper. The lighting is flat and even, as in a woodblock print, with no cast shadows. The overall composition is dynamic and asymmetrical, the wave framing the tower, calm and classical in mood.
